stages.name: F08/F09 POWER
stages.inputs: same-source primary A and companion B with F32 precision, six blocks, five217+LFE7; exact consumed short/other structure flags
stages.outputs: POWER=min(1,R32(R32(A*A)+R32(B*B))); raw I16 exponent via unsigned bit formula F09.2
stages.constraints: Use actual transformed coefficients; no log2 approximation or cache

stages.name: main POWER refresh
stages.inputs: raw POWER rows, per-channel fresh zero work, structure markers, mode1/secondary0; [0,128) FBW
stages.constraints: Freeze S current immediately after first refresh; tail128..216 raw unchanged; work/S/PRIMARY are distinct

stages.name: main strategy/normalization
stages.inputs: main markers+short overrides, reverse scan; primary-only strict-clipped coefficients
stages.outputs: main block strategies/pattern OR explicit strategy format; grouped anchors and expanded decoded exponents, gain; LFE own plan
stages.constraints: F09/F10 option1 main, one fixed plan per source; consumed clipped coefficients feed quantization

stages.name: converter refresh/strategy
stages.inputs: saved S, same consumed structural flags; fresh converter work per FBW channel
stages.outputs: independent converter refresh+reverse strategies+five matched frame codes
stages.constraints: No rerun transform; no use main frame code or main final work; unmatched converter pattern fatal

stages.name: converter exponent conversion
stages.inputs: main decoded exponent rows, converter reuse spans; LFE main strategy clock
stages.outputs: per-span binwise minimum, option0 normalization and expanded converted exponents: five217+LFE7 per block
stages.constraints: No main optimizer option1 second round; LFE does not run FBW POWER reanalysis

stages.name: F09G
stages.inputs: same-source own means/db state and transformed inputs per existing provider
stages.outputs: db_code[6] U2 fixed for converter and all main trials
stages.constraints: Compute once; candidate search must not advance provider or use old cached db codes

stages.name: converter candidate BAP
stages.outputs: BAP[6 blocks][5x217+7] U8 and per-block histograms
stages.constraints: Same public F12A integer network; caller context from all active same-block fine values, not this element alone

stages.name: converter fixed/mantissa cost
stages.inputs: independent converter strategies/packed group counts, LFE refresh/db changes/surround EX; actual candidate BAP
stages.outputs: H, F[6], M[6], auxiliary1; exact W16 cost; budget/partition residual
stages.constraints: BAP1/2/4 groups cross channels, reset each block; no quantization coefficients needed to count widths

stages.name: converter search
stages.outputs: binary trial trace, offset<=671 or0 fallback or failure
stages.constraints: Compute BAP/cost even q>671 before cap predicate; cost/residual equality accepts

stages.name: main candidate BAP
stages.inputs: fixed main expanded exponents and db codes, q shared across36 elements; tuple[2,1,1,db[b],7],fast_gain1
stages.constraints: Main q>=16 no zero bypass; reuse neither converter BAP nor previous q BAP

stages.name: main complete-trial oracle
stages.inputs: same fixed spectra/plan/dither/BSI/F13 payload plus freshly computed BAP
stages.outputs: R2 quantization/group result and R3 full actual body fields/size or specific failure
stages.constraints: Actual capacity32768-34 beforetail; converter residual/virtual budget cannot decide main feasibility

stages.name: main search
stages.inputs: test16 then low16 high784, atmost10 midpoints whilegap>1
stages.outputs: last successful candidate or no-best source failure
stages.constraints: Failure only trial scratch; no retransform/repolicy/re-dither. Quant sentinel/field failure makes q infeasible; pretrial producer error is fatal

orders.source: one fixed plan per codec source
orders.main_BAP_calls: 36 per candidate, each with its block db code

precision.POWER: R32 operations then exact F32 bit formula
precision.refresh: I16/W16 plus explicitly specified F32 error products
precision.BAP: I32 intermediate and S16 saturation, arithmetic right shift, no floats, no W16
precision.cost: W16 signed wrapping, reject negative where required; not BAP S16

cost_quantization_join: Mantissa count width agrees for valid quant codes only. Cost success does not waive R2 sentinel/nonfinite errors or R3 actual field/capacity failures.
